summary: Full backend + frontend verification of ISLA Proof. Ran 28 pytest cases (24 API via public URL + 4 core canonicalization/hash) — all passing. Validated public dashboard stats, project search/filter, project detail hides _original_name, public verify endpoint returns VERIFIED (PKG-001/002/003), TAMPERED (PKG-004), NOT_ATTESTED (PKG-005/006) with real on-chain Stellar Testnet readback. JWT login works for all 3 roles, /auth/me OK, wrong password 401. RBAC enforced: admin can create+attest package, reviewer/auditor get 403, auditor cannot attest, reviewer can approve evidence, admin/auditor get 403 on review. Audit requires auth. Tamper/restore cycle on PKG-2026-001 cycles VERIFIED→TAMPERED→VERIFIED correctly. One real Stellar Testnet attestation performed on freshly-created PKG-2026-007 (returned stellar_tx). Frontend: home hero/stats/grid render, search filters cards, project detail shows Timeline/Evidence/Packages tabs. /verify directory lists packages (uses data-testid verify-dir-<code>, NOT verify-link-<code> as noted in request). Clicking shows the big banner with data-result = VERIFIED/TAMPERED/NOT_ATTESTED and the SHA-256 side-by-side comparison; Stellar explorer link present for attested. Staff login redirects to /dashboard; nav shows Dashboard/Packages/Audit Trail; admin can run Modify evidence (tamper) and Restore original from the verify page and the banner updates correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Verify API response field is 'result' (not 'status') while package.status also exists on package entities — intentional and consistent, but worth noting in API docs.
data-testid naming on Verify directory items is 'verify-dir-<code>' not 'verify-link-<code>' as mentioned in the review request; code is self-consistent, request text was slightly off.
seed_data_creation: One new Draft package PKG-2026-007 was created and attested to Stellar Testnet during test_create_package_admin_ok + test_attest_draft_package. One additional attest on tamper/restore cycle for PKG-2026-001. All existing seeded packages PKG-2026-001..006 untouched in their expected end state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend fully green. If more test data is created, be mindful that each attest hits live Testnet. The verify API payload uses key 'result' (VERIFIED/TAMPERED/NOT_ATTESTED), not 'status'. Verify directory list items use data-testid='verify-dir-<package_code>'.
